PARRY — Combat Technique (Common)

Meeting an incoming blow on your own terms, rather than absorbing it on the body's terms.

A weapon in hand can turn aside a strike that would otherwise land clean — but a blade pushed past what it can bear will shatter, and a broken parry lands far worse than the blow it tried to stop.

Empty-handed, the same instinct still has value: a strike aimed at the torso can be caught and redirected into the arms instead — a price paid gladly, when the alternative is paid in full.

Know your weapon's limits before you trust it to someone else's swing.
